subject: Pre-PIP: initial coaching plan and documentation for Dev Patel
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pre-PIP: initial coaching plan and documentation for Dev Patel

Hi Laura/Marcus/Monica,

Following my 1:1 with Dev this morning, I'm documenting the key concerns and a proposed coaching approach so we have aligned next steps and evidence in case we need to escalate. I'm keeping this internal to people ops/HR + leadership for now. Attached: 20270510_irene_1-1-notes.pdf and a draft coaching plan spreadsheet.

Summary of concerns (examples & dates):
- Repeated missed deadlines on feature AX-112 (missed milestone 2027-04-21; created rework that delayed launch by 3 days).
- PR quality: 4/8 PRs in April required >2 rounds of fixes due to insufficient test coverage and unclear implementation (examples in notes).
- Customer impact: a minor production rollback on 2027-04-28 tied to an unsafe null-check in Dev's module (customer reported).
- Uptick in one-line responses and missed 1:1s (two missed 1:1s in March/April).

My read: performance has slipped on both execution and ownership. I think there's a path to recovery with a focused 30-day plan (clear milestones, paired work, and weekly documented check-ins). I do not want to go straight to a formal PIP without attempting targeted coaching first.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) Start a 30-day coaching plan focused on measurable deliverables (see attached coaching-plan spreadsheet).
2) Weekly written check-ins (manager notes) plus a 15-min paired session twice per week for code reviews/mentorship.
3) Reassign new feature ownership for two sprints to reduce blast radius.
4) Collect objective evidence (PR diffs, test results, incident timeline) and keep HR in the loop.

Questions for HR/legal: are there wording recommendations for the acknowledgement email? Should HR observe the initial coaching conversation? I can host the first coaching meeting the week of May 24 and share the acknowledgement template before the conversation.

Attaching: 20270510_irene_1-1-notes.pdf, 20270510_coaching-plan.xlsx

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-PIP: initial coaching plan and documentation for Dev Patel

Thanks for the write-up, Irene — this is helpful and appropriately documented. A few notes from HR perspective: 

- Tone & framing: when we present the plan to Dev, we should emphasize development and support ("30-day performance improvement plan/coaching") and be explicit about measurable outcomes. Avoid language that prejudges intent.
- Evidence: please add concrete examples in the spreadsheet (links to PRs, timestamps for missed 1:1s, and the incident report for the 2027-04-28 rollback). HR will preserve the attachments in the case file.
- Process: HR recommends a 30-day coaching period with two formal check-ins (day 14 and day 30) documented in writing. If written outcomes at day 30 do not show improvement, we will discuss transitioning to a formal PIP.
- HR attendance: HR can attend the initial coaching conversation upon your request; otherwise HR will provide a template acknowledgement for you to send and will remain on the thread for any escalations.

Please update the coaching-plan.xlsx with the concrete metrics and proposed owners for each milestone. Also include the mentor assignment for paired sessions. If you want, I can join a short calibration call before you speak with Dev.

Laura Bennett
People Operations Partner
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-PIP: initial coaching plan and documentation for Dev Patel

Irene — thanks for taking ownership on this. A couple of operational asks from my side: 

- Reassign major new-feature ownership (no new feature leads for Dev for the next 2 sprints) so we limit customer exposure.
- Explicit training slot: allocate 4 hours/week for pairing with senior eng (I suggest pairing with Priya for the first two weeks).
- Metrics: please capture a baseline for PR review cycle time and number of review rounds; that will let us quantify improvement.

I'm supportive of the 30-day coaching approach. If HR thinks the wording is suggestive of a formal action, please flag and Laura can provide alternative language.

Marcus Lin
Director of Engineering, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-PIP: initial coaching plan and documentation for Dev Patel (updated)

Thanks — I've updated the coaching-plan.xlsx with concrete examples and baseline metrics, and added a mutual action plan section. Key items (high level):

- Goals & success criteria:
  * Reduce PR rework: target <=1 follow-up round per PR on assigned tasks within 30 days.
  * Incident remediation: zero regression incidents attributable to the module for the coaching period.
  * Attendance: 100% of scheduled check-ins and 2x weekly pairing sessions.

- Milestones (week-by-week):
  * Week 1 (May 24–28): pairing 4 hrs/week, stabilize two outstanding PRs, baseline metrics recorded.
  * Week 2 (May 31–Jun 4): ownership limited to bugfixes/maintenance, mentor-led review sessions.
  * Week 3 (Jun 7–11): measurable reduction in review cycles; independent task completion with mentor sign-off.
  * Week 4 (Jun 14–18): final review, evaluation; if goals not met, escalate to formal PIP.

- Check-ins: weekly written notes + a formal day-14 and day-30 HR-reviewed summary.
- Consequence: clear escalation path to PIP if documented outcomes are not met.

I've attached the updated spreadsheet (20270510_coaching-plan.xlsx — updated tab "Mutual Plan"). I will schedule the initial coaching conversation for Tue, Jun 1 at 10:00am and would appreciate HR presence.

Irene

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-PIP: initial coaching plan and documentation for Dev Patel (updated)

All — I reviewed the updated plan. HR will: 

- File the coaching-plan and 1:1 notes into the central case (HR-CASE-2027-0421).
- Prepare an acknowledgement template (attached: 20270530_HR_ack_template.docx) for Irene to send during the initial coaching meeting; we can edit wording as needed.
- We recommend HR attendance for the initial coaching conversation on Tue, Jun 1 at 10:00am to ensure clarity on outcomes and next steps; Laura/Monica can join. Please confirm who will present the plan (Irene) and whether you want an intro statement from HR.

Two small compliance notes: keep all coaching content factual and time-stamped; avoid speculative language about intent or motive in written notes. Also, please limit distribution of the coaching-plan to the people on this thread.

If you confirm, I'll block time on HR's calendar and finalize the acknowledgement template.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
People Operations Partner
Redwood Inference
